461. Building Color Combinations

80

Problem Statement:
CP Inc gives you the task of building N buildings in a line . (1<=N<=1000000). The buildings are numbered from 1 to N (1-based indexing).The buildings come in two colors: red and blue

They want you to use a specific building style which can be described as follows:

1) We can build a red building. If we build a red building at some position i then i+1th building also has to be red. However the i+2th building can be of any color. This rule doesn't apply to the last building if it is red in color.

2) We can build a blue building at the current location . In that case the next building can be of any color we want.

Before you start building CP Inc being a company of competitve programmers decides to ask you what is the total number of ways you can build the buildings.

Report the answer modulo 1000000007.
input_spec: The first and only line of input contains a single integer N denoting the number of buildings that need to be built
output_spec: The output must consist of a single line
